title: Jets scrambled from Santa Cruz and Anápolis on the Night of UFOs
place_text: Santa Cruz, Rio de Janeiro and Anápolis, Goiás, Brazil

tellings.quote: And those jets flew from the base in Santa Cruz in the state of Hanei and from the Anapoulos air base in Guayis in the attempt to intercept the UFOs.

plain: Aldo Rebelo, who served as Brazil's defense minister, tells of the Night of UFOs, an evening in 1986 when unknown objects were reported in the skies over Brazil. He says fighter jets took off from the air base at Santa Cruz in the state of Rio de Janeiro and from the Anápolis air base in the state of Goiás to try to intercept the objects. Coming from a former defense minister, it would mean Brazil's own military treated the objects as real enough to chase.
